features.feature: Implement evaluateDecompositionGate as a new pure function in core/parallel-decomposition-gate.ts
Consume Story-1 overlap engine (computeWriteSet, globsOverlap, classifyBroadness) from core/parallel-decomposition-overlap.ts
Gate computes advisories[] plus an optional hard block reason from scope facts only; does NOT consult cfg.mode for enforcement (mode enforcement lives in Story 5 caller canStartDevGuard)
BLOCK reason overlap_declared_parallel: S asserts parallel AND tier-1 literal-path intersection with active peer P also asserting parallel (spec §4.3 cond.1)
BLOCK reason broad_glob_unprovable_parallel: S asserts parallel but write-set contains BROAD glob; hard block only when cfg.broadGlobBlocks=true, else advisory (spec §4.3 cond.2)

fake_dependency_chain advise-only: with StoryInfo.depends as string[] and no cited symbol, the falsifiable case is not evaluable in-model; gate never hard-blocks fake_dependency_chain (spec §4.3 cond.3, §4.5)
BLOCK reason peer_contract_unreadable_parallel: unreadable peer contract means independence is unprovable; fail-closed on parallel assertion (spec §4.8)
Tier-1 literal exact-path set-intersection triggers block; tier-2 shared-directory-prefix triggers advisory only (spec §4.2)
Filter active peers using terminalPhases={DONE, DISCARDED}; hoist and export TERMINAL_PHASES from parallel-policy.ts as single source (spec §4.3 preamble)
Fail-open: config-load failure or own contract unreadable -> treat as mode off, allow (spec §4.8)
No active peers -> no-op (trivially parallel-safe, mirrors summarizeParallelPolicy) (spec §4.8)
Hermetic smoke task: each block reason fires on its provable case and degrades to advisory on the non-provable case; clean disjoint decomposition returns block=null (CHK-002 title)
Smoke uses in-memory StoryInfo/ScopeContractData fixtures (no file I/O, no network) — hermetic
Smoke task registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands for CI integration
Wire evaluateDecompositionGate into canStartDevGuard (machine.ts) as the real PLAN->DEV decision predicate (spec §4.4 edit 1)
